room_rent.note: Policy pays Reasonable and Customary Charges for room rent with no stated sub-limit on room category in base cover.

icu.note: ICU charges covered up to Sum Insured with no separate sub-limit stated.

copayment.display: 20% (age 61–65, first-time entrants); 20% on Medical Treatment Abroad
copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay for insured persons aged 61–65 entering policy for first time (cannot be waived); 20% co-pay on all Medical Treatment Abroad claims (can be waived via optional add-on).

sub_limits.display: Cataract ₹1L/eye; Bariatric ₹10L; Prosthetics ₹10L; Maternity ₹1–2L; Mental health ₹1Cr cap; OPD ₹50k/yr
sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹1,00,000 per eye; Bariatric surgery up to ₹10,00,000; Prosthetic devices up to ₹10,00,000; Normal delivery ₹1L, C-section ₹2L; Mental healthcare capped at ₹1Cr; OPD sub-limit ₹50,000/yr; Domiciliary up to 10% of SI.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible in base plan. Family floater deductible applies on aggregate basis but no fixed rupee deductible is specified.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage from inception.

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (most); 36 months (joint replacement, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, osteoporosis)
specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, BPH, hydrocele, fibroids, stones, etc.; 36-month wait for rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint replacement surgery, age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis.

maternity.display: Covered (24 mo wait if both spouses covered; 36 mo if self only)
maternity.note: Normal delivery + pre/post natal up to ₹1,00,000; C-section + pre/post natal up to ₹2,00,000. Waiting: 24 months if self & spouse both covered, 36 months if only self covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: CB increases by 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100% of base SI. Reduces at same rate if claim made. OPD and Wellness claims do not affect CB.

restoration.display: Once/yr, 100% of base SI (unrelated illness only)
restoration.note: Restore Sum Insured equal to 100% of base SI triggered once per policy year after full SI + CB exhausted. Cannot be used for same/related illness for which claim was already paid. Not available for maternity claims.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (400+ listed) plus any new procedures due to tech advancement
day_care.note: Extensive list of 400+ day-care procedures in Annexure II; also covers any other surgeries/procedures requiring <24 hrs due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.display: Covered (up to 10% of SI, min 3 days treatment)
domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered up to 10% of base SI (excluding CB). Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient AYUSH hospitalisation)
ayush.note: AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) inpatient hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured. OPD AYUSH excluded under this benefit.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to Sum Insured when insured is recipient. Donor screening and post-hospitalisation expenses for donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to ₹50,000; Air ambulance up to ₹5,00,000 per policy year within India. Abroad ambulance also covered (excl. USA/Canada unless optional cover opted).

modern_treatments.note: Policy covers all medically necessary treatments including robotic/keyhole surgeries (e.g. CABG via minimally invasive, craniotomy, etc.) up to Sum Insured. No explicit modern treatment sub-limit stated.

consumables.note: Annexure III lists excluded consumables (gloves, masks, diapers, etc.). No consumables cover rider available.

global_cover.display: Inbuilt (listed critical illnesses & emergencies abroad, excl. USA/Canada); USA/Canada optional
global_cover.note: Medical Treatment Abroad (Benefit 2) is inbuilt for listed critical illnesses and emergencies outside India excluding USA & Canada. Extension to USA & Canada available as optional add-on (Benefit 25).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for all modes except monthly instalment which has 15 days.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or porting.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Not applicable for Medical Treatment Abroad and Maternity waiting periods.

notable_exclusions.display: Durable medical equipment (CPAP, glucometer, wheelchair); STDs (non-HIV); external congenital anomaly; stem cell storage; hormone replacement therapy; USA/Canada treatment (base)

optional_riders.display: Co-pay waiver for Medical Treatment Abroad; Treatment extension to USA & Canada
